results.title: Freshworks CRM Pricing – is it worth the cost?
results.content:
## FAQs

Freshsales CRM pricing starts at $0 for its free plan and goes up to $69 per user/month (billed annually) for the Enterprise Plan.

Freshsales CRM’s lower tiers lack advanced features like custom workflows and analytics, while higher-tier plans and add-ons can be expensive.

Freshsales CRM is ideal for small-to-medium sales and marketing teams looking for AI-driven insights and sales pipeline management tools. [...] Freshsales CRM (part of Freshworks) offers a range of plans designed to help businesses streamline their sales processes. With features like AI-driven insights, contact management, and automation, Freshsales is a strong contender for sales-focused teams. However, its pricing structure, especially for larger teams, makes it essential to evaluate its value compared to alternatives like Capsule CRM.

### Freshsales pricing plans

 Growth Plan – $11/user/month (billed monthly) [...] ## Why Capsule CRM is a strong alternative

Capsule CRM delivers everything Freshsales CRM offers – and more – with greater affordability and user-friendliness. Starting at just $18/month and including a free plan, Capsule is an excellent choice.

results.title: Freshsales Pricing 2026 | Is it Really Worth it?
results.content:
Read on to find out what features each plan includes and if it’s worth paying that bit extra for the Pro plan.

## How Much Does Freshsales Cost?

Growth is the most affordable of the three plans, with prices starting at $11/user/month. The Pro plan starts at $47/month per user, and the Enterprise tier comes in at $71.

Discounts are offered if you pay annually.

There is also a Forever Free plan available with limited features and no more than 3 users. [...] ## What’s missing?

Freshsales is predominantly a sales automation software, which is why you won’t find much in the way of email marketing features. Freshworks CRM does actually offer its own marketing services under its product ‘Freshmarketer’, but with prices starting at $15/month, you’d need a significant budget if you were to sign up for both this and Freshsales.

But wait, there’s actually a third product called Freshsales Suite that combines the top sales and marketing features in one. [...] | FREE | GROWTH | PRO | ENTERPRISE |
